verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OMULOKOZI Yesu
Ggwe atuyita mu nsi eno
Okukugoberera,
Kaakano tuzze gy'oli.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Tutandise-olugendo
-Okuyita mu nsi enoo;
Tukwate mu mikono
Tulyoke tuwangule.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Tuli banafu ddala
Ggwe-oli w'amaanyi
Kaakano tusuubiza
Okukugoberera.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Tetutya kabikonna,
Kubanga wasuubiza
Nti ffe mu mikono gyo
Tuli ba ddembe ddala.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Olugendo luwanvu
N'emitego mingi nnyo;
Naye bwe tuba naawe
Tulituuka mu ggulu
